title: First Dental
description: myfirstdental.com First Dental Care is a dental practice network in Massachusetts founded by Dr. Farshad Ghobbeh, who opened his first clinic in Medford in 2008 and expanded to Somerville in 2012 and four more locations including Arlington, Watertown, Acton and Bedford. With over 20,000 patients and 18 years of experience, it offers general and cosmetic dentistry, dental implants, Invisalign, emergency care and smile makeovers across six clinics. Its Smile Now Pay Later model with Klarna makes implants available from 58 dollars per month and whitening at 149 dollars instead of 500. The team is multilingual speaking English, Spanish, Portuguese, Russian, Chinese and Persian to serve diverse Massachusetts communities. It accepts over 15 insurance plans including Aetna, Blue Cross Blue Shield, Delta Dental and MassHealth. Key strengths are 18 years of community trust, multi-location accessibility, affordable payment plans and Dr. Ghobbeh's personal commitment to quality oral health.
